passage.text: Many high schools in Japan hold a school festival every year. Students prepare for the festival after class for several weeks, and in this way, they learn how to work as a team. Some students say that these weeks become the best memory of their school life.

illustrations.caption: 文化祭の準備をする教室。5人が別々の動作（看板を塗る女子／椅子に乗って飾りを吊る男子／色紙を切る女子／椅子を運ぶ男子／机でポスターに書く女子）。
歩道で自転車の横に立つ制服の男子。前輪がパンクしている。吹き出しに学校へ向かって走る姿、赤い斜線。

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. According to the passage, how do students learn how to work as a team?
questions.modelAnswer: By preparing for the school festival after class for several weeks.

questions.prompt: Do you think students should decide what to do at their school festival by themselves?

yes.modelAnswer: Students work harder when the idea is their own. They also learn how to make decisions together.

no.modelAnswer: Teachers know what is safe and what is possible. Students may choose something too difficult.

questions.prompt: These days, many students ride bicycles to school. Do you often ride a bicycle?

yes.modelAnswer: I ride my bicycle to school every day. It takes about fifteen minutes.

no.modelAnswer: My school is close, so I walk. I also think the roads near my house are dangerous.
